title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang on what kids should be studying in the age of AI
description:
What should parents suggest their children study to stay relevant in an age of widespread AI use? 

CNA correspondent Victoria Jen put this question to Nvidia founder and CEO Jensen Huang in a wide-ranging sitdown interview on Monday (May 25).

Watch out for the full interview on CNA's YouTube channel on Friday, 7.30pm SG/HK.
